For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Provision of assisting team in support of S&T staff for maintenance activities of S&T outdoor gears at BMZ, SMV, JPO, KQS, SBI, B IB, & SEX Stations of Jhansi division for a period of one year. SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF WORK (ATC) 1. Scope of Work: The contractor shall provide one skilled and one semi-skilled person at eac h of the following stations under ADSTE/LAR, Jhansi Division: NLRT, BRRI, LPGCL, UDPR and TKMG, for a period of 12 months, as per the approved scope of work and schedule of rates. 2. Deployment of Manpower: The contractor shall deploy a total of 05 skilled and 05 semi-s killed person, subject to the approved tender schedule. The personnel shall remain available at their respective stations and shall perform duties as directed by the authorized Railway re presentative. 3. Qualification and Experience: Skilled personnel shall possess ITI/Diploma or other releva nt technical qualifications in the appropriate trade, as specified in the tender. Semi-skilled p ersonnel shall possess the minimum educational qualification specified in the tender and sh all be capable of assisting skilled personnel in maintenance activities. 4. Maintenance Activities: The deployed team shall assist Railway S&T staff in maintenance, upkeep and failure attention of Point Machines, Track Circuits, Signals, Axle Counters, cables , batteries, chargers, transformers, location boxes and other S&T equipment, as directed by the authorized Railway representative. 5. Safety Precautions: All work shall be carried out under the supervision and authorization o f Railway officials. The contractor's personnel shall strictly follow applicable Railway safety r ules, instructions and precautions while working near railway tracks, points, signals and oth er operational installations. No safety-critical operation shall be undertaken independently b y the contractor's personnel. 6. Tools and Equipment: The contractor shall arrange, at its own cost, the necessary tools, t ackles, personal protective equipment (PPE), uniforms and other items required for the work , except materials specifically agreed to be supplied by the Railway under the contract. 7. Communication Facility: The contractor shall provide each team with a functioning mobile phone and ensure effective communication with the concerned SSE/JE/S&T staff and the aut horized Railway representative. Contact details of deployed personnel shall be furnished bef ore commencement of work. 8. Attendance and Supervision: The contractor shall maintain daily attendance and station- wise deployment records. These records shall be verified by the authorized Railway represe ntative before certification of the monthly service performance and processing of bills. 9. Replacement of Personnel: In case of absence, resignation, leave or unsatisfactory perfor mance of any deployed person, the contractor shall arrange a suitable replacement within t he period prescribed in the contract. Any applicable penalty for non-deployment or delayed replacement shall be imposed as per the approved GeM contract/SLA. 10. Minimum Wages and Statutory Payments: The contractor shall pay wages not less than

the applicable minimum wages notified by the competent Government authority. EPF, ESI, b onus, leave wages and other statutory benefits shall be paid wherever applicable. Document ary proof of wage payment and statutory remittances shall be submitted as required by the contract. 11. Bank Payment of Wages: Wages shall be paid directly into the bank accounts of the depl oyed personnel through the prescribed banking channel. 12. Weekly Rest and Leave Relief: The contractor shall make its own arrangements for week ly rest, leave and other absences in accordance with applicable labour laws and the approve d manpower requirement. No additional payment shall be admissible for such arrangements unless specifically provided in the contract. 13. Identity Cards and Verification: Before deployment, the contractor shall submit the list o f personnel along with identity proof, address proof, qualification certificates and medical fit ness documents, as required under the contract. Police verification shall be furnished where ver stipulated. All personnel shall carry valid contractor-issued identity cards while on Railw ay premises. 14. Uniform and Discipline: The contractor shall ensure that all deployed personnel wear the prescribed uniform and identity badge, maintain proper discipline and comply with the instr uctions of authorized Railway officials. Any personnel found unsuitable, negligent or guilty of misconduct shall be replaced as per the contract conditions. 15. Emergency Duties: In the event of an S&T failure or emergency, the team shall assist Rail way staff at the locations specified by the competent authority, subject to the scope of work and applicable safety procedures. Any movement beyond the specified stations shall be gov erned by the contract provisions and instructions of the competent authority. 16. Transportation and Accommodation: The contractor shall make its own arrangements fo r transportation, accommodation, food and other facilities for its personnel. No free transpor t, accommodation or other personal facilities shall be provided by the Railway unless specifi cally provided in the contract. 17. Protection of Railway Property: The contractor shall be responsible for loss or damage to Railway property attributable to the negligence or misconduct of its personnel, subject to as sessment and recovery in accordance with the applicable contract conditions and rules. 18. Labour Law Compliance: The contractor shall comply with the applicable labour laws, stat utory registrations, working-hour requirements, weekly rest provisions and other statutory o bligations. The contractor shall be responsible for its employees and for maintaining all pres cribed employment and wage records. 19. No Employer-Employee Relationship: The personnel deployed by the contractor shall re main employees of the contractor. Their deployment shall not create any employer-employe e relationship with Indian Railways or confer any right to regular employment or absorption i n Railway service. 20. Subletting: The contractor shall not assign or sublet the contract, wholly or partly, without prior written permission wherever required under the applicable GCC and contract condition s. 21. Inspection and Performance Monitoring: The Railway administration may inspect atten dance, deployment, tools, safety compliance and the quality of assistance provided by the c ontractor's personnel. Deficiencies shall be rectified within the time stipulated by the authori zed Railway representative. 22. Payment of Bills: Payment shall be made in accordance with the GeM contract terms agai nst satisfactory performance, certification by the authorized Railway representative and sub mission of prescribed bills, attendance records, wage-payment proof and applicable statutor y compliance documents. 23. Penalty for Deficiency: Penalties and recoveries for non-deployment, unauthorized absen ce, delayed replacement, unsatisfactory performance or other contractual deficiencies shall be governed by the applicable GeM SLA, GCC and approved tender conditions. 24. Applicable Conditions: These Special Conditions shall be read together with the approved GeM bid, scope of work, GCC for Services, applicable SLA and relevant Railway instructions. In case of inconsistency, the applicable contractual provisions and prevailing Railway/GeM r ules shall govern.

Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA AND ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS The following eligibility criteria and conditions shall be applicable for technical evaluation of the bi d for the work Provision of assisting team in support of S&T staff for maintenance activities of S&T outdoor gears at BMZ, SMV, JPO, KQS, SBI, BIB, & SEX Stations of Jhansi division for a period of one year (7 station) A. SPECIAL ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA 1. Financial Turnover The bidder shall have an average annual financial turnover of not less than 150% of the advertised tender value, as prescribed under GCC for Services, 2018, Para 2.6.1.2, subject to the applicable t ender provisions. The turnover shall be supported by audited financial statements and a certificat e issued by a Chartered Accountant (CA), duly indicating the membership number and UDIN, wher ever applicable. 2. Past Experience of Similar Services As per GCC for Services, 2018, Para 2.6.1.1, and the applicable GeM bid conditions, the bidder sha ll have successfully completed similar services during the current financial year and the preceding three financial years ending in March prior to the bid opening date. The required experience shall be fulfilled by any one of the following: i. Three similar completed services, each costing not less than 40% of the advertised tender value ; or ii. Two similar completed services, each costing not less than 50% of the advertised tender value; or iii. One similar completed service costing not less than 80% of the advertised tender value. The bidder shall upload valid work orders/contracts along with completion certificates issued by th e competent authority/client. The documents must clearly indicate the nature of work, contract val ue, period of execution and successful completion of the work. 3. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) As per Service GCC, Clause 3.3, Para 3.3.1, and the applicable GeM bid conditions, the bidder shall submit EMD at the rate of 2% of the advertised tender value, wherever stipulated in the bid. Exemption, if any, shall be allowed strictly in accordance with the applicable GeM provisions and R ailway instructions. The bidder claiming exemption shall upload valid supporting documents establ ishing eligibility for the exemption. 4. Definition of Similar Nature of Work Similar nature of work shall mean maintenance support services involving maintenance of S&T out door gears and equipment, including but not limited to Signal gears, Point Machines, Track Circuit s, Axle Counters and other related S&T equipment. The definition of similar nature of work shall be governed by Dy. CSTE/P&D-I/NCR letter No. NCR/S&T/4019/Works/Similar Nature of Work/Part-4 dated 15.10.2024. The bidder shall submi t experience certificates clearly establishing execution of work of the specified similar nature. Exp erience certificates relating to unrelated services shall not be considered.

5. Declaration Regarding Blacklisting/Debarment The bidder shall submit a duly signed and dated declaration regarding blacklisting, debarment or banning by any Government Department, Public Sector Undertaking, Indian Railways or other com petent authority, as required by the bid conditions. The declaration shall bear the name of the bidder/authorized signatory and, wherever required, th e GeM Bid Number. Any false declaration or suppression of material facts shall be dealt with as per applicable rules and contract conditions. 6. Acceptance of ATC and Special Conditions The bidder shall upload the duly signed and dated acceptance of all applicable Additional Terms a nd Conditions (ATC), scope of work, technical requirements and Special Conditions of Contract. The acceptance shall clearly identify the relevant GeM Bid Number and shall be signed by the prop rietor, partner or duly authorized signatory. All documents specifically required to be signed or acc epted under the bid shall be submitted accordingly. 7. Legal Status and Constitution of the Firm The bidder shall clearly specify its legal status, such as Proprietorship, Partnership Firm, Limited Li ability Partnership (LLP), Company or other legally recognized entity, and upload the relevant regi stration/incorporation documents. In the case of a partnership firm, the bidder shall submit the partnership deed, registration certific ate wherever applicable, details of partners and authorization of the signatory. Documents shall b e duly authenticated/notarized wherever legally required or specifically stipulated in the bid. In the case of a company or LLP, the relevant incorporation certificate and authorization of the per son signing the bid shall be submitted. 8. Registration and Statutory Documents The bidder shall submit applicable registrations and certificates, including PAN, GST registration, E PF and ESI registration, and labour licence/registration wherever required under applicable law and the nature of the contract. Where a particular registration or licence is not applicable at the bidding stage, the bidder shall fur nish an appropriate declaration, subject to the applicable legal requirements and bid conditions. B. ADDITIONAL ELIGIBILITY AND CONTRACT CONDITIONS 10. Compliance with Labour Laws and Statutory Obligations The successful bidder shall comply with GCC for Services, 2018, Para 6.2, and all applicable labour laws, rules and statutory provisions in force, including the applicable provisions relating to: i. Payment of minimum wages and timely payment of wages. ii. Employees' Provident Fund (EPF) and Employees' State Insurance (ESI), wherever applicable. iii. Working hours, weekly rest, overtime and other applicable employment conditions. v. Maintenance of wage registers, attendance records, employment records and other statutory re gisters. vi. Compliance with applicable provisions of the labour codes and the corresponding existing enact ments/rules to the extent in force. The successful bidder shall submit the prescribed proof of statutory compliance along with the rele vant bills/invoices or whenever demanded by the Railway administration. 11. Minimum Wages and Price Quotation The bidder shall quote its rates after duly considering the applicable minimum wages, statutory co ntributions, leave benefits, bonus wherever payable, and all other applicable statutory liabilities. or other established contractual defaults. 12. Penalty for Deficiency in Service In the event of non-deployment of required manpower, unauthorized absence, unsatisfactory perf ormance, failure to comply with safety instructions or other deficiencies, penalties/recoveries shall be imposed strictly in accordance with the applicable Service GCC, GeM contract, Service Level Ag reement (SLA) and the penalty provisions specified in the bid. C. MANDATORY DOCUMENTS FOR TECHNICAL EVALUATION The bidder shall upload the following documents, as applicable to the bidder and specifically requi red under the bid: 1. Audited financial statements and CA-certified turnover certificate. 2. Work orders/contracts and completion certificates for similar services.

3. EMD proof or valid exemption documents, as applicable. 4. Signed declaration regarding blacklisting/debarment. 5. Signed and dated acceptance of ATC and Special Conditions. 6. Proof of legal status and constitution of the firm. 7. PAN and GST registration documents, as applicable. 8. EPF/ESI registration and applicable labour licence/registration documents, or the prescribe d declaration where legally permissible. 9. Any other document specifically required under the GeM bid and applicable Railway instru ctions. Note: The above documents shall be examined during technical evaluation. Non-submission of an essential document or failure to meet a mandatory eligibility criterion may result in rejection of the bid, subject to the applicable GeM provisions and tender conditions. Clarifications or additional doc uments shall be sought only where permitted under the applicable rules. The above conditions shall be read in conjunction with the applicable GeM General Terms and Con ditions, Service-specific Terms and Conditions, Service GCC, SLA and the approved scope of work. In the event of any inconsistency, the applicable contractual provisions and prevailing Railway/Ge M instructions shall govern.
